9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Introduction*:

2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.

4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season . *Benefits*:

question: पशुपालनासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजना आहेत?
answer:
पशुपालनासाठी महाराष्ट्र शासनामार्फत खालील प्रमुख शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत (फक्त PoCRA/नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्पांतर्गत निवडलेल्या गावांसाठी):

1. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प बकरी पालन (Goat Rearing)**
   - ही योजना भूमिहीन, विधवा, घटस्फोटित व परित्यक्त महिलांसाठी आहे.
   - बकरीपालन व्यवसायाला चालना देऊन, स्वतःचा रोजगार उपलब्ध करून देणे, व ग्रामीण भागातील उत्पन्न वाढवणे हा मुख्य उद्देश आहे.
   - लाभार्थ्याने किमान ५ वर्षे हा व्यवसाय सुरू ठेवावा लागतो.
   - अर्जदारासाठी भूमिहीन असल्याचा प्रमाणपत्र, आणि जर शक्य असेल तर जात प्रमाणपत्र व इतर आवश्यक कागदपत्रे आवश्यक आहेत.
   - ऑनलाइन अर्जासाठी Mahavistaar-AI मोबाईल अ‍ॅप किंवा "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" वेब साइटवरून अर्ज करता येतो.
   - निधी थेट बँक खात्यावर जमा केला जातो.
   - **सुचना:** ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे.

2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प आंतरदेशीय मत्स्यपालन (Inland Fishery)**
   - ज्या शेतकऱ्यांकडे ८-१० महिने पाणी साठवण असलेली शेततळी आहेत, त्यांनी पूरक व्यवसाय म्हणून मत्स्यपालन सुरू केल्यास उत्पादनात व उत्पन्नात वाढ करता येते.
   - लाभ घेण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्याने इतर कोणत्याही योजनेचा लाभ घेतलेला नसावा.
   - अर्ज Mahavistaar-AI अ‍ॅप किंवा PoCRA पोर्टलवर करायचा आहे.
   - **सुचना:** ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी लागू आहे.

3. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट (Organic Production Unit)**
   - शेतकरी बांधवांना शेतावरील कचरा, वायकट शाकभाजी यांचे कंपोस्ट करून सेंद्रिय खत निर्मितीसाठी प्रोत्साहन दिले जाते.
   - लाभासाठी अर्जदाराकडे दोन मोठी जनावरे (गाय, म्हैस, बैल) असणे आवश्यक आहे व जमीनधारकाची क्षेत्रफळ मर्यादा ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत असावी.
   - अर्ज प्रक्रियेची माहिती व Mahavistaar-AI अ‍ॅपची मदत घेता येते.
   - **सुचना:** ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी उपलब्ध.

4. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प रेशीम उत्पादन युनिट (Sericulture Unit)**
   - शेतकऱ्यांना निवडक क्षेत्रामध्ये किमान ०.४० हेक्टर जमीन आणि योग्य सिंचन सुविधा असणे आवश्यक आहे.
   - या योजनेचा उद्देश ग्रामीण भागात रेशीम उत्पादन व्यवसाय वाढवून उत्पन्न व रोजगार वाढवणे हा आहे.
   - अर्ज प्रक्रिया पूर्णपणे ऑनलाइन स्वरूपात (Mahavistaar-AI अ‍ॅप/PoCRA पोर्टल) पार पडते.
   - **सुचना:** ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी लागू आहे.

वरील सर्व योजनांसाठी अर्ज Mahavistaar-AI अ‍ॅप किंवा महाPoCRAची अधिकृत वेबसाईटद्वारे करा. आवश्यक कागदपत्रांची यादी व संपूर्ण अर्ज प्रक्रिया ऑनलाइन आहे.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण आपल्या गावाचा PoCRA यादीत समावेश आहे का हे स्थानिक कृषि अधिकारी किंवा पंचायत कार्यालयाकडे तपासा. आणखी कोणत्या पशुपालनविषयक योजनेविषयी माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Sub Component*:
1. Sangamneri/ Osmanabadi Breed
2. Local Breed

*Introduction*:
Climate change is observed to have an adverse impact on the state's agriculture, and the scope of this impact is expected to increase in the future, as noted in the state's Climate Change Action Plan. Farmers in Marathwada and Vidarbha have been facing severe droughts for the past few years, which has adversely affected groundwater reserves and soil health. Consequently, the productivity of agricultural crops has decreased. The Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp has been launched by the Government of Maharashtra with financial assistance from the World Bank, with the objective of empowering farmers to adapt to the situation arising from climate change. 
The "Goat Rearing" component has been included under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to provide supplementary income to landless families in the project area and to generate employment in rural areas.

*Benefits*:
1. To provide supplementary income to landless individuals, widows, deserted, and divorced women in the villages included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp through the "Goat Rearing" component.
2. To provide self-employment opportunities to the youth in rural areas.
3. To rear breeding goats of species that can thrive in the local environment.
4. To promote the goat rearing business in rural areas.

*Eligibility*:
1. Benefits from this scheme will be given to only one person from a family.
2. Beneficiaries who have already received benefits from any other scheme will not be eligible for benefits under this scheme.
3. The beneficiary must engage in the said business for a minimum of 5 years.
4. Person from landless family, widow, divorced & abandoned women will be only eligible for this component.

*Required Documents*:

2. Certificate from the Tahsildar that person belongs to landless family

4. Certificate of the Gramvikas Adhikari for widow, abandoned women, and divorced women.
5. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.

3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.

दूध काढणीसाठी 'मिल्किंग मशीन' (दुग्धकेंद्री यंत्र) खरेदीसाठी तुम्ही खालील शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेऊ शकता:

1. **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**
   - या योजनेअंतर्गत ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्रसामग्री, तसेच दुग्धकेंद्री (मिल्किंग) मशीनसाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य दिले जाते.
   - एससी, एसटी, लघु शेतकरी, महिला यांना किमान ४०% अनुदान, तर इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ५०% किंवा सरकारने ठरवलेल्या मर्यादेपर्यंतचे अनुदान मिळू शकते.
   - पात्रता: कोणताही वैयक्तिक शेतकरी.

2. **केंद्रीय कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण उपमिशन (Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization)**
   - केंद्र सरकारमार्फत देखील ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, मिल्किंग मशीन व इतर यंत्रांसाठी अनुदान मिळू शकते.
   - पात्रता व अनुदान रक्कम राज्य योजनेसारखीच (४०% ते ५०% पर्यंत).
   - अर्जासाठी mahadbt पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा.

3. **कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (Custom Hiring Centre) योजना**
   - शेतकरी गट, महिला बचत गट, एफपीओ, सहकारी संस्था यांना यंत्र सामुग्री बँक/कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर स्थापन करण्यासाठी ४०% अनुदान व कृषी पदवीधरांना ५०% पर्यंत/५ लाख रुपये अनुदान मिळू शकते.
   - या मधून मिल्किंग मशीनसुद्धा पुरवठा केला जाऊ शकतो.
   - आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: खरेदी करण्याच्या यंत्राचा कोटेशन, चाचणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टर ड्रायव्हन उपकरणांसाठी RC, गट किंवा एफपीओ असल्यास पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र.

सर्व योजनेला अर्ज mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन करावा लागतो. अर्ज करताना शिफारसी प्रमाणपत्र, बँक खात्याचा तपशील आणि आधार कार्ड आवश्यक असते.

तुमची पात्रता, दस्तऐवज व मिळणाऱ्या अनुदानाबाबत अधिक माहिती तसेच सहाय्यासाठी जवळच्या कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: माझ्या पिकासाठी कोणती शासकीय योजना आहे?
answer:
आपल्या दिडगाव (ता. सिल्लोड, जि. छ.संभाजीनगर) येथील 1.3 हेक्टर क्षेत्रासाठी पुढील शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

१.  **नमो शेतकरी महानमान निधी (NSMNY)**  
हे PM-KISAN योजनेच्या लाभार्थ्यांना मिळणारे अतिरिक्त लाभ आहे. वर्षाला एकूण **₹6,000** तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये मिळतात. पात्रता – आपल्याला PM-KISAN योजनेचा लाभ मिळत असावा, ७/१२ उतारा, आधार व KYC झालेले असणे आवश्यक आहे. स्वतंत्र अर्जाची गरज नाही, PM-KISAN योजनेत नोंद असावी.
  
२.  **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
या योजनेत आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल शेतकरी कुटुंबांना (ज्यांच्याकडे शेती आहे) वर्षाला एकूण **₹6,000** तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये (₹2,000 प्रति हप्ता) मिळतात. अर्ज https://pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन करता येतो. आवश्यक कागदपत्रे – ७/१२ उतारा, आधार, विल्गॉर्मन बँक खाते, KYC प्रमाणीकृत असावे.

३.  **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
ही योजना अनुसूचित जाती व नव बौध्द शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे. (आपली जात 'General' असल्यामुळे, आपण या योजनेसाठी पात्र नाही. फक्त माहिती म्हणून दिले आहे.) यात नवीन विहीर, शेततळे, पंप, सिंचन, मशागतीचे साहित्य यासाठी विविध अनुदाने मिळतात. अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर करावा लागेल.

४.  **प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीडरोग, पाऊस न पडणे इ. मुळं पिकाचे नुकसान झाल्यास विम्याची भरपाई मिळते. यासाठी शेतकरी, ज्यांनी अधिसूचित भागात व पिकावर नोंदणी केली आहे, पात्र आहेत. अर्ज pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर केला जातो.

५.  **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना**  
कृषी यांत्रिकीकरणासाठी (उदा. ट्रॅक्टर, पावर टिलर, फवारणी पंप, इम्प्लिमेंट्स) ५०% पर्यंत अनुदान मिळते. अर्ज https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

६.  **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – ड्रिप सिंचन**  
आपल्या गावासाठी सध्या ही योजना खुली नाही, कारण ही फक्त PoCRA गावांसाठी आहे.  

वरील योजनांपैकी NSMNY, PM-KISAN, PMFBY, व यांत्रिकीकरण योजनेसाठी आपण पात्र आहात. त्यांच्या अर्ज प्रक्रिया व कागदपत्रे काळजीपूर्वक पूर्ण करा. कुठल्याही अर्जात अडचण आल्यास आपल्या तालुका कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेंची सविस्तर माहिती अथवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेची मदत हवी आहे का?

question: डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:
डाळिंब लागवडीसाठी व मका लागवडीसाठी महाराष्ट्र शासनाच्या शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत. खालील दोन प्रमुख योजना यासाठी लागू होतात:

१. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – फळबाग लागवड (डाळिंबासाठी)**
ही योजना खास ग्रामीण भागातील हवामान बदलाचा सामना करण्यासाठी आणि शाश्वत उत्पन्न देणाऱ्या दीर्घकालीन फळबाग लागवडीसाठी आहे. या योजनेत डाळिंबासह इतर फळबागांची लागवड करता येते.

- **फायदे:** शाश्वत उत्पन्न, हवामान प्रतिकारशक्ती, मातीची धूप कमी होते, हिरवाई वाढते.
- **अर्हता:** ज्या शेतकऱ्यांना याआधी या जमिनीवर अन्य योजनांचा लाभ घेतला नाही, तेच पात्र. लागवडीत ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत लाभ मिळतो. आवश्यक सिंचनाची सोय असावी.
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** महापोकरा DBT पोर्टल किंवा "महाविस्तार-AI" मोबाईल अ‍ॅप वरून अर्ज करता येतो. आधार आणि बँक खाते लिंक असणे आवश्यक. अर्ज संपूर्ण कागदपत्रांसह ऑनलाइन करावयाचा आहे.
- **लक्षात घ्या:** ही योजना केवळ पोकरा (PoCRA) गावांसाठीच लागू आहे.

२. **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा व पोषण अभियान – मका (Crop Demonstration)**
या योजनेत मका (मक्क्याचा) उत्पादन, तंत्रज्ञान वापर आणि सुधारित वाण प्रचारासाठी गट पातळीवरील Krishi Producer Company किंवा Farmer Producer Groupsना आर्थिक मदतीसह प्रात्यक्षिके (Demonstration) करण्यासाठी मदतीची तरतूद आहे.

- **अर्हता:** अर्ज करणारा शेतकरी गट/कंपनी शासनमान्य संगठनेच्या अंतर्गत नोंदणीकृत असावा. प्रत्येक कुटुंबातील फक्त एकच सदस्यला लाभ.
- **प्रक्रिया:** प्रथम येईल त्याला प्राधान्य, तसेच गटातील सर्व शेतकरी Agristack वर नोंदणीकृत असणे आवश्यक आहे.

तपशीलवार पात्रता नियम, आवश्‍यक कागदपत्रे व अर्ज प्रक्रिया प्रत्येक योजनेसाठी वेगळी आहे. आपल्याला अधिक माहिती, अर्जाचा मार्ग किंवा अर्ज प्रगतीसाठी mahapocra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर किंवा स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनांसाठी अर्ज कसा करायचा किंवा आवश्यक कागदपत्रांबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Introduction*:
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change. The plantation of fruit orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change is an objective of this project.

*Benefits*:
1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit crops. 
2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture plantation. 
3. To establish orchards of long-term, income-generating fruit crops that survive on less water, providing a supplementary business to rainfed agriculture. 
4. To reduce soil erosion and promote the conservation of green cover. 
5. To increase Carbon Sequestration.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the land falls under the Tenancy Act and the tenant's name is on the 7/12 extract, a consent letter from the tenant will be required to implement the scheme.
3. The selected beneficiary for this component should not have availed government subsidy earlier for plantation activities (such as fruit orchards, tree plantation, bamboo, etc.) on the said area.
4. The beneficiary should have the necessary irrigation facilities required for the cultivation of the proposed fruit crop.
5. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries holding up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, certificate related to that.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

*Introduction*:
1. To increase the production and productivity of food grain crops by adopting modern technology developed through research by Agricultural Universities, techniques of resource-based tillage (resource management practices), and high-yielding varieties that provide increased output in a shorter time.
2. To use newly released varieties and adopt new technologies on farmers' fields.
3. To undertake actions to achieve the productivity enhancement targets set block-wise for crops like Paddy (Rice), Pulses, Wheat, Millets (Maize), and Nutri-Cereals (Jowar/Sorghum, Bajra/Pearl Millet, Nachani/Finger Millet, Varai/Barnyard Millet).
4. To improve soil texture, maintain pest/disease control, conserve moisture in the crop, and increase yield through demonstrations based on intercropping and cropping systems.

*Eligibility*:
1. The crop demonstrations should be implemented by Farmer Groups/Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs)/Cooperative Societies working in the agriculture sector, etc.
2. The farmer group must be registered before March 31, 2024.
3. The farmer group must be registered with any government agency (e.g., ATMA, Maharashtra State Rural Livelihood Mission (MSRLM), National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM), Mahila Arthik Vikas Mahamandal (MAVIM), NABARD, etc.).
4. The benefit should be provided to only one person from a single family (husband, wife, and children below 18 years).
5. If the group selected for the crop demonstration has more than 25 farmers, the concerned group should select 25 farmers.
6. The selection of Farmer Group/Company/Institution registered on the MahaDBT Portal for crop demonstrations will be done on the principle of First Come, First Served (FCFS) for those who apply first.
7. It is mandatory for the farmers in the group to be registered on Agristack to receive the benefit of the crop demonstration.
8. For the selection of beneficiaries for demonstrations based on the cropping system, only those farmers who are prepared to take crops in both seasons and have the necessary resources available accordingly should be selected.

completeness.evidence: डाळिंबसाठी फक्त NDKSP दिली; सार्वत्रिक पर्याय जसे Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation (mahadbt-bfhps), MIDH area expansion मिस झाले. मक्यासाठी फक्त Demonstration दिले; NFSM seed distribution सारखे वैयक्तिक लाभ पर्याय गाळले.

context_fit.evidence: PoCRA अट स्पष्ट केली पण Agristack ❌ असल्याने PoCRA नसलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी पर्यायी फळबाग योजना (BFHPS/MIDH) सुचवली नाही.

clarity.evidence: दोन्ही योजनांचे उद्देश/अर्हता वेगवेगळी, बुलेटमध्ये स्पष्ट मांडणी.

conversation_closure.evidence: शेवटी मदतीचा सामान्य प्रश्न विचारला; अधिक विशिष्ट पुढील पावले (उदा., तुम्हाला वैयक्तिक की गट अर्ज हवा?) विचारता आले असते.

grammar.evidence: वाक्यरचना आणि व्याकरण योग्य; समजण्यास सोपे.

language_purity.evidence: बहुतेक मजकूर शुद्ध मराठीत; आवश्यक त्या ठिकाणी इंग्रजी योजना नावे स्वीकार्य आहेत.

question: माझ्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?
answer:
आपल्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक (पॉवर टिलर) यंत्र खरेदीसाठी खालील महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेता येतो:

१. **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**  
या योजनेत ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, स्वयंचलित यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टर चालित अवजारे यांसारख्या उपकरणांसाठी शेतकऱ्यांना अर्थसहाय्य (सब्सिडी) दिले जाते.  
- पात्रता: कोणताही वैयक्तिक शेतकरी  
- लाभ: सामान्य शेतकऱ्यांसाठी यंत्राच्या किमतीपैकी ४०% किंवा सरकारने ठरविलेली सीमा, यापैकी कमी असलेली रु. मिळते.  
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: यंत्राचा कोटेशन, तपासणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टर चालवत असल्यास ट्रॅक्टरचे आरसी  
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा.  
**स्रोत: राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना**

२. **केंद्रीय उप-अभियान कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization)**  
ही केंद्र सरकारची योजना असून ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर व विविध कृषी अवजारे खरेदीसाठी अनुदान मिळते.  
- पात्रता: कोणताही वैयक्तिक शेतकरी  
- लाभ: सामान्य शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ४०% वा केंद्र सरकारने ठरविलेली मर्यादा, यापैकी जे कमी असेल तेवढ्या किंमतीपर्यंत सब्सिडी दिली जाते.  
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करा.  
**स्रोत: उप-अभियान कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण**

३. **कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर (CHC) साठी अनुदान**  
जर आपण शेतकरी समूह, शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी, सहकारी संस्था, महिला बचत गट इ. मार्फत यंत्र सामायिकरित्या (कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर) विकत घेत असाल तर, केंद्र आणि राज्य योजना अंतर्गत उपकरणांच्या किंमतीवर ४०%/५०% पर्यंत किंवा कमाल ठरविलेल्या मर्यादेपर्यंत अनुदान मिळू शकते.  
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: संस्था नोंदणी प्रमाणपत्र, यंत्राचा कोटेशन, तपासणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टरचे आरसी  
**स्रोत: राज्य व केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर**

४. **फळबागांसाठी यांत्रिकीकरण (MIDH - Tractor 2WD, 4WD Schemes)**  
जर आपल्या शेतात फळबाग लागवड असेल, तर "मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर" या योजनेतही ट्रॅक्टरसाठी अर्ज करता येईल.  
- लाभ: किमतीच्या ५०% पर्यंत किंवा निश्‍चित मर्यादेपर्यंत (साधारणपणे रु. १.६० लाख सामान्य शेतकऱ्यांसाठी)  
**स्रोत: MIDH योजना**

सर्व अर्ज mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवरच ऑनलाईन करावे लागतात.  
आपल्या नावावर १४ हेक्टर जमीन आहे, कास्ट वर्ग सामान्य आहे, आणि आपण लातूर जिल्ह्यात आहात – तशी पात्रता व मर्यादा लागू होतील.

आपल्याला विशिष्ट योजना, कागदपत्रांची मदत किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेसाठी अधिक माहिती हवी असेल का?

**स्रोत: राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना, उप-अभियान कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण, MIDH (केंद्रीय योजना)**

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.

question: पिकांच्या लागवडीसाठी शेतकरी मशीनरीसाठी कोणत्या अनुदान योजना उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
शेतकऱ्यांसाठी पिक लागवडीसाठी यंत्रे किंवा मशिनरी खरेदीसाठी खालील महत्वाच्या अनुदान योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

१. **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यंत्रीकरण योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**
- या योजनेत ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, विविध कृषि अवजारे, ट्रॅक्टरवर चालवता येणारी कृषि साखळी व प्रक्रिया अवजारे यासाठी अनुदान मिळते.
- सर्वसाधारणपणे अनुसूचित जाती, जमाती, लहान शेतकरी, महिला शेतकरी यांना उपकरणे किंमतीच्या ४०% किंवा जास्तीतजास्त मर्यादेच्या मर्यादेचे अनुदान, आणि इतरांना ५०% अनुदान दिले जाते.
- शेतकऱ्यांनी https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर अर्ज करायचा आहे.
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: उपकरणाचा कोटेशन, तपासणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टरवर चालणाऱ्या अवजारांसाठी RC.

२. **कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर (CHC) आणि कृषी मशिनरी बँक (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization - CHC)**
- किसान ड्रोन व कृषी अवजारांच्या भाडेकरता किंवा केंद्र स्थापनासाठी अनुदान मिळते.
- कृषि पदवीधरांना खर्चाच्या ५०% किंवा कमाल ५ लाख रुपये अनुदान, इतर लाभार्थ्यांना ४०% किंवा कमाल ४ लाख रुपये अनुदान.
- अर्जाची प्रक्रिया व आवश्यक कागदपत्रे वरील योजनेसारखीच आहे.

३. **केंद्र पुरस्कृत कृषी यंत्रीकरण उपमिशन (Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization)**
- ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, जंगले, कापणी आणि प्रक्रिया अवजारे यासाठी अनुसूचित जाती, जमाती, लहान शेतकरी, महिला शेतकरी यांना ४०% अनुदान आणि इतर शेतकऱ्यांना ५०% अनुदान दिले जाते.
- अर्जाची प्रक्रिया राज्य योजनेसारखीच आहे.

४. **नमो ड्रोन दीदी योजना (Namo Drone Didi)**
- ग्रामीण भागातील महिला स्वयं सहाय्यता गटांना ८०% किंवा कमाल ८ लाख रुपयांपर्यंत ड्रोन आणि जोड उपकरणे अनुदानावर दिली जातात.
- अर्ज निवड क्लस्टरनिहाय होते.

५. **Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture – Tractor/Power Tiller**
- बागायतीसाठी २ व्हिल ड्राईव्ह ट्रॅक्टर (SC, ST, महिला – २ लाख अनुदान, इतर शेतकरी – १.६ लाख रुपये), पॉवर टिलर (SC/ST/लहान – १ लाख, इतर शेतकरी – ०.८ लाख रुपये) वरील मर्यादेत ५०% किंवा ४०% अनुदान मिळते.

हे सर्व अनुदान www.mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करून मिळवता येतात. निवड प्रक्रियेत प्रथम येणाऱ्याला प्रथम संधी (FCFS) नियम आहे. सर्व व्यवहार थेट बँकेत डीबीटीद्वारे केले जातात. 

आपल्याला यातील कोणती योजना, प्रक्रिया किंवा कागदपत्रांबाबत अधिक माहिती हवी असल्यास कृपया विचारा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack ❌; agent correctly avoided personalization and provided general scheme information.

term_identification.evidence: Mapped the farmer’s need (farm/planting machinery) to the right set of schemes: State & Central mechanization, CHC, drone, and MIDH tractor/power tiller.

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → multiple get_scheme_info calls. Did not batch with get_multiple_schemes_info despite fetching 2+ schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or raw outputs exposed; farmer-facing summary only.

source_alignment.evidence: Benefits and caps align with tools (e.g., SDDA 40% for SC/ST/small/women & 50% others; CHC 40% capital, drone 50%/40% with ₹5L/₹4L caps; Namo Drone Didi 80% or ₹8L; MIDH tractor ₹2.0L/₹1.6L; power tiller ₹1.0L/₹0.8L). Minor deviation: MIDH tool shows application via https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in but response generalized to mahadbt portal.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes or amounts; statements mirror tool outputs; no promises on timelines or guaranteed subsidy.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the expected generic citation: “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती” for scheme info.

safety_compliance.evidence: Content is administrative (schemes); no chemical advice or unsafe practices suggested.

completeness.evidence: Covers main machinery schemes (state/central mechanization, CHC, drone, MIDH). Misses explicitly separating Central CHC benefits and does not list scheme-specific documents/process for each.

actionability.evidence: Gives portal URL, mentions FCFS and DBT, and lists key documents for mechanization scheme; actionable starting points.

context_fit.evidence: General guidance appropriate for broad audience with Agristack ❌. Could have clarified individual vs group eligibility where relevant and MIDH-specific portal.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured numbered list; concise bullets per scheme improve readability.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic offer for help; could ask targeted follow-up (machine type, HP, individual vs group) to guide next steps.

grammar.evidence: Overall correct Marathi sentences; minor typographical inconsistencies do not hinder comprehension.

terminology.evidence: Uses correct terms like अनुदान, अर्ज, कागदपत्रे, पण काही इंग्रजी योजना नावे/शब्द (State Sponsored, Custom Hiring Centre, FCFS) ठेवली आहेत.

language_purity.evidence: English limited to scheme names/standard acronyms (DBT, FCFS), acceptable per guidelines.

fluency.evidence: Informative but slightly list-like; could be more conversational and localized.

evaluation.summary: Accurate, organized overview of major farm machinery subsidy options with correct benefits and application guidance. Improvements needed on portal specificity (MIDH), clearer state vs central CHC distinction, and more scheme-specific documents/process plus a targeted follow-up question.

question: शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर घेण्यास कोणती योजना मदत करते?
answer:
शेतासाठी हार्वेस्टर किंवा शेतकरी यंत्र घेण्यासाठी खालील प्रमुख योजना सहाय्य करतात:

१. **State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization (राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण योजना):**
   - या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना ट्रॅक्टर, हार्वेस्टर, पॉवर टिलर, इतर आधुनिक यंत्रे आणि ट्रॅक्टर ऑपरेटेड उपकरणे खरेदीसाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य दिले जाते.
   - लघु, सीमा, अनुसूचित जाती आणि महिला शेतकऱ्यांना ४०% पर्यंत तर इतरांना ५०% पर्यंत किंमतीवर किंवा केंद्र शासनाने ठरविलेल्या कमाल मर्यादेपर्यंत अनुदान मिळते.
   - पात्रता: सर्व शेतकरी.
   - अर्ज प्रक्रिया: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा लागतो. निवड FCFS (First Come First Serve) पद्धतीने होते.
   - आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: खरेदीचे quotation, यंत्राची चाचणी अहवाल, ट्रॅक्टर RC (जर लागलेच), इ.

२. **State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization (Custom Hiring Centre) (राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण – कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर):**
   - या योजनेत कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर उभारणीसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते. हार्वेस्टर, ड्रोन व अन्य यंत्रे सामूहिकरित्या उपलब्ध करून देता येतात.
   - लाभ: यांत्रिक बँक किंवा कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर स्थापन करण्यासाठी एकूण भांडवली खर्चाच्या ४०% पर्यंत अनुदान. कृषी पदवीधरांना ड्रोन साठी खर्चाच्या ५०% (कमाल रु. ५ लाख) व इतरांसाठी ४०% (कमाल रु. ४ लाख) पर्यंत अनुदान उपलब्ध.
   - पात्रता: वैयक्तिक शेतकरी, शेतकरी गट, महिला स्वयं-सहायता समूह, शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी, सहकारी संस्था, इ.
   - अर्ज प्रक्रिया व आवश्यक कागदपत्रे वरीलसारखीच आहेत.

३. **Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization (केंद्र सरकार- कस्टम हायरींग सेंटर):**
   - या केंद्र शासनाच्या योजनेतही कस्टम हायरींग सेंटरसाठी व ड्रोन यंत्रांसाठी वरील प्रमाणेच आर्थिक सहाय्य उपलब्ध.
   - पात्रता, अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया, आणि कागदपत्रे राज्य योजनेप्रमाणेच आहेत.

या सर्व योजना https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवरून अर्ज करता येतात. निवड प्रक्रिया पारदर्शक आणि ऑनलाईन आहे. हार्वेस्टर किंवा इतर शेतमाल यंत्रे घेण्यासाठी या योजनांचा लाभ घ्या.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण कोणत्या प्रकारच्या हार्वेस्टर खरेदी करू इच्छिता? किंवा आपल्याला अर्ज प्रक्रियेत मदतीची गरज आहे का?

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

question: माझ्या गावात काही पीक सुधारणा योजनेची नोंदणी कशी करावी?
answer:
आपल्या गावातील पीक सुधारणा योजनेत सहभागी होण्यासाठी खालील माहिती आपल्या फायद्याची आहे:

**१. नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – बियाणे निर्मिती (NDKSP Seed Production):**
ही योजना प्रामुख्याने PoCRA प्रकल्पातील गावांसाठी आहे. याचा उद्देश हवामानाला तोंड देणाऱ्या आणि दर्जेदार जातीच्या बियाण्यांची निर्मिती व पुरवठा वाढविणे आहे.
- बियाणे निर्मितीसाठी 'SATHI' पोर्टलवर नोंदणी आवश्य असते.
- पात्रता: कोणत्याही जमिनीच्या आकारास बंधन नाही.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया:
  1. “Mahavistaar-AI Application” गुगल प्ले स्टोअरवरून डाउनलोड करा.
  2. आपला रजिस्टर केलेला “Farmer ID” वापरून लॉगिन करा.
  3. ‘DBT’ टॅब आणि नंतर ‘NDKSP’ टॅब निवडा.
  4. आवश्यक तपशील भरून नोंदणी पूर्ण करा.

**टीप**: आपले गाव कुंभारी हे PoCRA प्रकल्पातील नाही, त्यामुळे ही योजना थेट उपलब्ध नाही. 

**२. नॅशनल फूड सिक्युरीटी मिशन – बियाणे वितरण (NFSNM Seed Distribution):**
या योजनेद्वारे सुधारित व दर्जेदार बियाण्यांचे वाटप होते.
- लाभ: ५०% किंवा शेतकऱ्यांनुसार निश्चित केलेली रक्कम (उदा. गहू, तांदूळ: ₹२,०००/ प्रतिक्विंटल किंवा ५०%, जे कमी असेल, तसा अनुदान).
- एकाच शेतकऱ्याला कमाल १ हेक्टरसाठीच अनुदान उपलब्ध.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: अधिकृत बियाणे वितरकाकडून सातबारा, आधारकार्ड, बँक खाते तपशीलसह अर्ज करा.

**३. नॅशनल फूड सिक्युरीटी मिशन – बियाणे उत्पादन:**
ही योजना केवळ सरकारी बियाणे उत्पादक संस्थांसाठी आहे (उदा. महाबीज, NSC, NAFED).

आपल्या गावाच्या (कुंभारी, तालुका रेणापूर, जिल्हा लातूर) शेतकऱ्यांसाठी NFSNM बियाणे वितरण योजना अधिक उपयुक्त आहे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:** सातबारा उतारा, आधार, बँक खाते तपशील, जात प्रमाणपत्र (लागू असल्यास), अपंग प्रमाणपत्र (लागू असल्यास), खातेधारकांसाठी संमतीपत्र (सांयुक्त खात्यासाठी).

**अधिक माहितीसाठी आपल्या गावातील कृषी सहाय्यक किंवा तालुका कृषी अधिकारी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.**

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला कोणत्या विशिष्ट पिकासाठी बियाण्याचे अनुदान हवे आहे का? कृपया खाते तपशील किंवा पिकाचे नाव कळवावे, जेणेकरून मी अधिक मार्गदर्शन करू शकेन.

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Seed Production

*Sub Component*:
Seed Production

*Introduction*:
Through the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project, climate-resilient farming technology is being disseminated in 7201 villages in all districts of Marathwada and Vidarbha, as well as Jalgaon and Nashik districts. For this, along with climate-resilient technology, basic infrastructure is also being provided to the farmers. The use of quality seeds is essential for increasing the production and productivity of major crops grown in the project area. For this, it is imperative to increase the seed replacement rate for pulses, oilseeds, and cereal crops in the project area. Therefore, special efforts are being made under the project to make seeds of climate-resilient varieties of major crops available to farmers. In climate-resilient varieties, emphasis should be placed on short-duration varieties, pest and disease-resistant or tolerant varieties, drought-tolerant varieties, etc. Additionally, the quality of the produced variety must also be appropriate for the market. 
With the objective of strengthening the seed production chain of major crops in the project area, the following component is being implemented under the project

*Benefits*:
1. To make seeds of climate-resilient varieties of major crops available in the villages within the project area. 
2. To increase the participation of small farmers in the seed production chain of climate-resilient varieties. 
3. To empower seed-producing farmers and Farmer Producer Companies to create economic stability.

*Eligibility*:
1. The seed production program must be registered with the Seed Certification Agency through the SATHI portal.
2. A registered seed production program of varieties with climate-resilient characteristics should be undertaken.
3. There shall be no restriction regarding the maximum landholding for the farmer willing to undertake seed production.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/%20Production_of_Breeder_and_Certified_Seeds_of_Climate_Resilient_Varieties.pdf

question: माझ्या बटाट्याच्या पिकासाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये मी अर्ज करू शकतो?
answer:
आपल्या बटाट्याच्या (पोटॅटो) पिकासाठी आपण खालील शासकीय योजनांमध्ये अर्ज करू शकता:

१. **प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
ही योजना बटाटा आणि इतर अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी लागू आहे. निसर्ग आपत्ती, कीड, रोग यामुळे उत्पादनात नुकसान झाल्यास विमा संरक्षण मिळते. सर्व शेतकरी (कर्जधारक व बिगर कर्जधारक) अर्ज करू शकतात. अर्ज करताना ७/१२ उतारा, आधार कार्ड, बँक तपशील, शेतीविषयक सर्व माहिती आणि ई-पिक पहाणी आवश्यक आहे. अर्ज ऑनलाइन www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करायचा आहे.
 
२. **नॅमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**
ही योजना PM-KISAN लाभार्थ्यांसाठी आहे. पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना दर वर्षी **₹६,०००** अनुदान मिळते (तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये). विशेष अर्जाची आवश्यकता नाही; आपण PM-KISAN साठी पात्र असलात तर लाभ मिळतो.

३. **पिकानंतर व्यवस्थापन – फळ, भाजीपाला, कांदा, बटाटा पॅकहाऊस इत्यादी (Onion storage structure, Packhouse & Integrated Packhouse)**
या योजनेंतर्गत शेतकरी, शेतकरी समूह, शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपनी (FPO), शेतकरी महिलांचे समूह, SHG, सहकारी संस्था यांना आपल्या उत्पादनाच्या योग्य साठवणुकीसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते.  
• शेतातच भाजीपाला धुणे, वर्गीकरण, पॅकिंग यासाठी फॉर्म गेट पॅकहाऊससाठी प्रकल्प खर्चाच्या ५०% (कमाल ₹२,४०,०००) अनुदान मिळू शकते.
• इंटीग्रेटेड पॅकहाऊससाठी सामान्य भागात ३५% (कमाल ₹५,६०,०००) व अनुसूचित क्षेत्रात ५०% (कमाल ₹८,००,०००) अनुदान मिळू शकते.
• अर्ज ऑनलाईन महाराष्ट्र DBT पोर्टलवर करायचा आहे. आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: ७/१२ उतारा, बँक पासबुक, आधार, प्रकल्प कागदपत्रे.

४. **कांदा/बटाटा साठवण कोल्ड स्टोरेज – MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture)**
या योजनेद्वारे बटाट्यासाठी थंड साठवण (कोल्ड स्टोरेज) बांधकामासाठी ३५% ते ५०% अनुदान (क्षेत्रीअंनुसार जास्तीत जास्त ₹२.१ कोटी किंवा ₹३ कोटी) मिळते. हे प्रकल्प सहकारी संस्था, शेतकरी समूह, FPO इ. च्या नावावर लागू होतात. या योजनेचे अर्ज व इतर प्रक्रिया सुद्धा DBT पोर्टलवर आहेत.

वरील योजनांसाठी लाभ, पात्रता, आवश्यक कागदपत्रे आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया संपूर्णपणे ऑनलाईन पद्धतीने आहे.

आपल्या नावावर १४.०२ हेक्टर क्षेत्र आहे, आपण सामान्य वर्गातील शेतकरी आहात व रेणापूर, लातूर या परिसरात राहता; त्यामुळे वरील सर्व योजना आपल्यासाठी उपलब्ध आहेत, मात्र पिक विमा योजनेसाठी पिकाची अधिसूचना व PM-KISAN/NSMNY लाभासाठी पात्रता तपासावी लागेल.

कृपया अधिक माहितीसाठी किंवा अर्ज करताना मार्गदर्शन हवे असल्यास स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी/ सहाय्यक यांच्याशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या पिकांसाठी आणखी कोणी अनुदान किंवा सबसिडी योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Scheme Name*:

*Main Component*:
Horticulture- Cold storages, pre-cooling, processing units, etc. (Integrated Post hectareverst Management)

*Sub Component*:
FARM GATE PACKHOUSE

*Introduction*:
Horticultural crops in the state suffer from significant post-hectarervest losses, usually amounting to 20-40 percent of the production. Packing of fruit and vegetable products maintains their quality and reduces losses during transportation and distribution to the market. Farm gate pack house is required for hectarendling and processing of fresh fruits, vegetables, etc. to be exported. In farm gate pack house, fruits are packed before transportation or distribution.

*Benefits*:
1. Cleaning, grading and packing of the produced horticultural, medicinal and aromatic products in the field itself, to the required weight/size and temporary storage.
2.To extend the shelf life and quality of perishectareble goods such as fruits, flowers, vegetables, medicinal and aromatic plants.
3. To enhectarence the quality of the product by performing primary processing on the raw material without chectarenging its original form.
4. Reduce the number of intermediaries and ensure thectaret the direct producer gets a fair price and makes goods available to consumers at reasonable prices.
Subsidy is 50% of project cost - Rs. 240000/-

*Eligibility*:
1. farmers to hectareve an horticultural crop.
2.The beneficiaries of this scheme are individual farmers, groups of farmers, Self-Help Groups - which will hectareve at least 25 members, Farmers' women's groups, Farmers' Producer Organizations, registered agricultural organizations, farmers' cooperatives, cooperative marketing associations can be involved.

*Required Documents*:
1.Agristack Farmer ID (Documents regarding ownership of the project, a) 7/12 and 8A extract)
2. Photocopy of Aadhectarear card
3. Photocopy of the first page of the bank passbook
4. Guarantee (hectaremipatra) 5. Bond (Bandhpatra) 6. Bills / Invoices

Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.

4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
आपण नवीन शेतकरी आहात तसेच अनुसूचित जमाती (ST) प्रवर्गातील शेतकरी असल्यामुळे खालील शासकीय योजना आपल्या पंचक्रोशीत आणि परिस्थितीनुसार सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत:

१. **बिरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna – mahadbt-bmkky)**
- अनुसूचित जमातीतील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सिंचन सुविधा, शेततळे, विहीर, सौर पंप, शेतमशीनरी, ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन, बागायत, प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग, माती परीक्षण इ. साठी अनुदान.
- आपल्या सारख्या ०.४ हेक्टर ते ६ हेक्टर जमीनधारक ST शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ही योजना उपलब्‍ध आहे, केवळ महसूल नोंद असणं (७/१२ प्रमाणपत्र), जात प्रमाणपत्र आणि आधारशी लिंक असलेले खाते आवश्यक.
- ऑनलाइन अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया आहे – MahaDBT पोर्टलवर आपल्या मोबाइलवरून किंवा कॉम्प्युटरवरू अर्ज करू शकता.
- अधिक माहितीसाठी – स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा तलाठी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधावा.

२. **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY – mahadbt-nsmnyy)**
- सर्व PMKISAN लाभार्थी शेतकऱ्यांना अतिरिक्त **रु. ६,००० प्रतिवर्ष** एकूण तीन हप्त्यांमध्ये मिळतात.
- अर्ज स्वतंत्रपणे करण्याची आवश्यकता नाही – आपण PMKISAN लाभार्थी असाल तर आपोआप या योजनेसाठी पात्रता असते.
- आपला आधार व जमीन नोंद महाDBT / PMKISAN पोर्टलवर अपडेट असावी.

३. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PMKISAN – mahadbt-pmkisan)**
- संपूर्ण भारतातील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ज्या कुटुंबाकडे शेती आहे, त्यांना दरवर्षी **रु. ६,०००** तीन समान हप्त्यांत मिळतात.
- ७/१२ प्रमाणपत्र, आधार लिंक आणि ई-केवायसी आवश्यक.
- pmkisan.gov.in वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज किंवा अद्यावतीकरण करता येते.

वरील योजनांमध्ये विशेषतः Birsa Munda Yojna (ST शेतकरी) ह्या योजनेचा आपल्याला जास्त फायदा होईल, कारण आपला जमीनाचा तुकडा आणि प्रवर्ग तसा आहे. सर्व अर्ज MahaDBT पोर्टलद्वारे ऑनलाइन करणे शक्य आहे.

**अर्जासाठी लागणारी प्रमुख कागदपत्रे:**
- SC/ST जात प्रमाणपत्र (आपल्यासाठी ST),
- ७/१२ उतारा (मालकी असलेली जमीन),
- आधारशी लिंक असलेले बँक खाते.

अधिक माहितीसाठी उर्वरित सर्व अर्ज आणि मार्गदर्शनासाठी स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी यांच्याशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला कोणत्या योजनेबद्दल सविस्तर माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रिया समजून घ्यायची आहे का?

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the      concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: मी सोयाबीन आणि कापूस दोन्ही पिकतो, कोणत्या योजनेत अर्ज करणे फायदेशीर आहे?
answer:
तुमच्याकडे ०.६८ हेक्टर क्षेत्र आहे, तुम्ही अनुसूचित जमाती (ST) प्रवर्गातील आहात आणि नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अक्कलकुवा तालुक्यात सोयाबीन आणि कापूस ही दोन्ही पिके घेत आहात. या माहितीच्या आधारावर, खालील योजना तुमच्यासाठी सर्वाधिक फायदेशीर आहेत:

१. **National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) – Commercial Crop – Cotton Development Scheme**  
या योजनेत कापूस पिकासाठी समाविष्ट आहे. यामध्ये आंतरपीक प्रात्यक्षिक, उच्च घनतेच्या लागवडीचे प्रात्यक्षिक, बियाणे उत्पादन, कीड व्यवस्थापनासाठी रासायनिक आणि जैविक कीटकनाशके, ऑनलाइन कीड निरीक्षण सेवा, आणि विविध प्रशिक्षण यांचा समावेश आहे.
- लाभः आंतरपीक प्रात्यक्षिकासाठी ८,००० रुपये/हे., उच्च घनतेसाठी १०,००० रुपये/हे., बियाणे उत्पादनासाठी ९,००० रुपये/हे., आणि अन्य बाबींवरही अनुदान.
- पात्रता: गट लाभार्थी (काही घटकांसाठी वैयक्तिक पात्रता)
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज.

२. **National Mission on Edible Oils – Oilseeds (NMEO-OS):**  
सोयाबीन पिकासाठी उपयुक्त आहे. या योजनेत सुधारित बियाणे वितरण, तांत्रिक मार्गदर्शन, प्रशिक्षण, आणि फळ व्यवस्थापनासाठी अनुदान दिले जाते.
- लाभः सुधारित जातींच्या बियाणांचा प्रसार, शेतकरी प्रशिक्षण, बाजाराशी जोडणी, गोडाऊन बांधकामासाठी अनुदान.
- पात्रता: मूल्य साखळी क्लस्टरमध्ये असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांना प्राधान्य.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: महाडीबीटी पोर्टलद्वारे निवड.

३. **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY):**  
कापूस आणि सोयाबीन दोन्ही पिकांसाठी विमा संरक्षण. पिकाची नासधूस, निसर्ग आपत्ती, कीड किंवा रोगामुळे नुकसान झाल्यास आर्थिक मदत मिळते.
- लाभः पीक नष्ट झाल्यास विमा भरपाई.
- पात्रता: नोंदणीकृत शेतकरी, लोनी/नॉन-लोनी दोघांनाही लागू.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: pmfby.gov.in पोर्टलवर अर्ज.

४. **Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (NSMNY):**  
ज्या शेतकऱ्यांना PMKISANचा लाभ मिळतो, त्यांना वर्षाला ६,००० रुपये अतिरिक्त लाभ मिळतो.
- पात्रता: PMKISANचे लाभार्थी शेतकरी.

५. **Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY):**  
तुम्ही अनुसूचित जमाती (ST) प्रवर्गातील असल्याने irrigation (सिंचन), विहीर, पंपसेट, प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग, तसेच शेतमजूर व इतर कृषी यंत्रासाठी जास्तीत जास्त ५०,०००–४,००,००० रुपयेपर्यंत अनुदान मिळू शकते.
- पात्रता: SC/ST प्रवर्गातील शेतकरी, ०.२० ते ६.०० हे. क्षेत्र असणे आवश्यक.

वरील सर्व योजनांचा फायदा तुम्ही घेऊ शकता. पीक विम्यासाठी, पीक डेमोन्स्ट्रेशन (प्रात्यक्षिक) आणि सिंचन/यंत्र अनुदानासाठी संबंधित योजना निवडा.

**अर्जाची लिंक:**  
महाडीबीटी पोर्टल: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin

जर तुम्हाला अर्ज करताना अधिक मदतीची किंवा मार्गदर्शनाची गरज असेल, तर स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा तालुक्याच्या कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आणखी कोणत्या शेतीविषयक योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेबद्दल तुम्हाला मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?

*Introduction*:
National Mission on Oilseed and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched by Government of India in year 2014-15. In 2018-19 GoI has merged NMOOP with NFSM as NFSM (OS&OP).  Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).
         The Central Government has approved a new Mission called National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds for the years 2024-25 to 2030-31. This has been done to promote the production of oilseed crops with primary focus on mustard, groundnut and soybean and to focus on secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO) along with other oilseed crops. Secondary Vegetable Oil Sub-mission is also part of the National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) mission and has been included in it, which mainly includes oil extraction from secondary sources like cottonseed, rice bran and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO). Under this mission, 27 districts of Maharashtra have been selected for soybean, groundnut, safflower, mustard, Niger, sunflower and sesame. The mission will be implemented through Value Chain Cluster (VCC) and for this, a farmer producer company/cooperative/public or private organization will be selected as the Value Chain Partner (VCP) for each cluster. 4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी महाराष्ट्रात उपलब्ध असलेली प्रमुख शासकीय योजना म्हणजे **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – सेंद्रिय उत्पादन युनिट (NDKSP-Organic Production Unit)**. या योजनेच्या माध्यमातून शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीखते, कीटकनाशके इ. रसायने न वापरता सेंद्रिय व जैविक घटकांचा उपयोग करणे, शेतातील जैव कचऱ्यापासून वर्मीकंपोस्ट व नाडेप खत तयार करणे, आणि जमिनीची सुपीकता व पाणी धारण क्षमता वाढवणे याचा लाभ मिळतो.

मुख्य फायदे:
- परिसरातील नैसर्गिक साधनांचा उपयोग करून आरोग्यदायी, पोषक धान्य मिळविणे आणि शेतीचा खर्च कमी करणे.
- शेतीची माती सुपीक व सेंद्रिय ठेवून उत्पादन वाढवणे.
- स्थानिक उपलब्ध गोष्टींचा पुन्हा वापर करणे.
- नाडेप कंपोस्ट किंवा वर्मीकंपोस्ट युनिट करण्यासाठी आर्थिक मदत.

पात्रता:
- लाभार्थी शेतकऱ्याने या घटकासाठी पूर्वी कोणत्याही योजनेतून लाभ घेतलेला नसावा.
- युनिट चालवण्यासाठी किमान दोन मोठी जनावरे (गायी, म्हशी, बैल) असणे आवश्यक.
- एका पत्नीवर जास्तीत जास्त ५ हेक्टर पर्यंत जमीन धारकाला लाभ मिळवता येईल.

आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:
- अपंग असल्यास प्रमाणपत्र.
- अनुसूचित जाती/जमाती असल्यास जात प्रमाणपत्र.
- संयुक्त खाते असल्यास अन्य भागधारकांची संमतीपत्र.

अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया:
1. शेतकरी "Mahavistaar-AI Application" मोबाईल अ‍ॅप डाउनलोड करून स्वतःच्या शेतकरी आयडीने लॉगिन करा.
2. डॅशबोर्डवरील "DBT" टॅबवर क्लिक करा. नंतर "NDKSP (PoCRA)" निवडा.
3. विविध घटकांकरिता अर्ज करा.
4. किव्हा mahapocra.gov.in या वेबसाईटवर जाऊन अर्ज करू शकता.
5. अर्ज करताना आधार क्रमांक बँक खात्याशी जोडलेला असणे आवश्यक आहे.

महत्त्वाचे:

*Id*:
