*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-organic-production-unit

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Vermicompost_and_NADEP_Compost_Production_Unit_Guidelines.pdf

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी खालील योजना जास्त अनुदान देतात:

१. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY):**
- ही योजना अनुसूचित जाती किंवा नव-बौद्ध असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे.
- 0.20 हेक्टर ते 6 हेक्टर जोत असणाऱ्यांना अनेक कृषी बाबतीत अनुदान दिले जाते.
- बाबी उदा.• नवीन विहीर – जास्तीत जास्त ₹4,00,000 अनुदान
   • जुन्या विहिरीची दुरुस्ती – ₹1,00,000
   • प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग – रकमेसाठी ९०% अनुदान, कमाल ₹2,00,000
   • इनवेल बोअरिंग – ₹40,000
   • विज जोडणी – ₹20,000 किंवा प्रत्यक्ष खर्च, जे कमी असेल ते
   • पंपसेट किंवा सोलर पंप – ₹40,000–₹50,000
   • ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर/मशागत – एकूण खर्चाच्या ९०% पर्यंत अनुदान, वेगवेगळ्या घटकांसाठी वेगवेगळ्या मर्यादा
   • शेतीच्या इतर अवजारांसाठी देखील अनुदान

- अर्ज https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in वर ऑनलाइन करावा लागतो.
- पात्रता – अनुसूचित जाती प्रमाणपत्र, 0.40 हेक्टर ते 6 हेक्टर जोत असलेले शेतकरी. (तुम्ही "General" वर्गात आहात म्हणून ही योजना लागू नाही.)

२. **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY):**
- सर्व लहान व सीमांत शेतकरी अखिल महाराष्ट्रात पात्र आहेत (पात्रतांच्या आधारावर).
- कुटुंबाला दरवर्षी ₹6,000 तीन समान हफ्त्यांत मिळतात.
- ही रक्कम पीएम किसान योजनेसह अतिरिक्त मिळते. अर्ज करण्याची आवश्यकता नाही फक्त पीएम किसान लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक.

३. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN):**
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमजोर, मिळकतीच्या मर्यादेत असलेले, शेती करणारे कुटुंबे (पती-पत्नी आणि १८ वर्षाखालील मुले) पात्र.
- दरवर्षी परिवाराला ₹6,000 तीन हफ्त्यांत दिले जातात.
- अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर.

सर्व योजनांसाठी 1.81 हेक्टर जोत असल्याने (तुमच्या नावावर) व "General" वगैरे वर्ग नसल्यामुळे बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजनेत तुम्ही पात्र नाही. पण NSMNY आणि PM-KISAN मध्ये तुम्ही अर्ज करू शकता किंवा आधीच लाभ घेत असाल.

जर तुम्हाला यातील अर्ज कसा करावा किंवा कुठल्या कागदपत्रांची गरज आहे याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी असेल, तर कृपया सांगा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण अजून कोणत्या विशिष्ट योजनांबद्दल किंवा आपल्या शेतीसाठी अनुदानाचा लाभ वाढवण्यासाठी कोणत्या पर्यायांबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

State

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
आपल्या केळी बागेसाठी सरकारी योजनेचा फायदा घेण्यासाठी खालील प्रमुख योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

१) **Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme (भाऊसाहेब फुंडकर फळबाग लागवड योजना)**
- ही राज्य शासनाची योजना असून, शाश्वत उत्पन्न, रोजगार निर्मिती, व साधारण १६ कायमस्वरूपी फळपिकासाठी लागवड (केळी, आंबा, डाळिंब, सफरचंद, संत्रा, लिंबू, इ.) करता येते. 
- १००% अनुदान हप्त्यांमध्ये थेट आधार लिंक बँक खात्यावर दिले जाते. 
- लाभार्थी निवड महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर लॉटरी पद्धतीने होते.
- अर्जासाठी: ७/१२ उतारा किंवा ८अ, आधार कार्ड, आधार लिंक बँक खाते आवश्यक आहे.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा.

२) **Krishonnati Yojana – Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) – Area Expansion (क्षेत्रविस्तार)**
- ह्या केंद्र शासनाच्या योजनेत फळ, फुल, मसाळा पिके लागवडीसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते. 
- विशेषतः अनुसूचित जमातीसाठी ५०% अनुदान मिळते.
- पात्रता: किमान ०.२० हेक्टर जमीन असावी. केळी, पेरू, डाळिंब, आवळा, डाळिंब, लिंबू अशा फळ पिकांसाठी अर्ज करता येतो.
- अर्जासाठी: शेतकरी आयडी, ७/१२ किंवा ८अ, बँक पासबुक, जातीचा दाखला, आवश्यक असल्यास संमतीपत्र, बिले/पावत्या.
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा.

३) **Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp (NDKSP) – Horticulture Plantation**
- ही योजना 'PoCRA' गावांसाठी मर्यादित आहे. आपला गाव PoCRA योजनेत नाही, त्यामुळे ही योजना आपणास लागू नाही.

आपण अनुसूचित जमातीमध्ये (ST) असल्याने दुसऱ्या योजनेत जास्त अनुदान मिळू शकते. आपण ०.६८ हेक्टर क्षेत्रधारक आहात, त्यामुळे वरील दोन्ही योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात. महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर अर्ज करताना जातीचा दाखला आणि जमीन कागदपत्रे अपलोड करावीत.

तपशीलवार मार्गदर्शन किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेत मदतीसाठी आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधावा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला अर्ज प्रक्रियेबद्दल किंवा आवश्यक कागदपत्रांबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Horticulture Plantation

*Sub Component*:
1. Horticulture Plantation-Mango Grafts
2. Horticulture Plantation-Mango High-Density Plantation
3. Horticulture Plantation-Cashew Grafts
4. Horticulture Plantation-Guava Grafts
5. Horticulture Plantation-Pomegranate Grafts
6. Horticulture Plantation-Kagzi Lime Grafts
7. Horticulture Plantation-Kagzi Lime Seedlings
8. Horticulture Plantation-Orange / Sweet Lime Grafts
9. Horticulture Plantation-Orange Grafts (Indo-Israel method)
10. Horticulture Plantation-Custard Apple Grafts
11. Horticulture Plantation-Amla Grafts
12. Horticulture Plantation-Tamarind Grafts
13. Horticulture Plantation-Jamun Grafts
14. Horticulture Plantation-Kokum Grafts
15. Horticulture Plantation-Jackfruit Grafts
16. Horticulture Plantation-Fig Grafts
17. Horticulture Plantation-Sapota Grafts
18. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings Banawali (with polybag)
19. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings Banawali (without polybag)
20. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings T x D (with polybag)
21. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings T x D (without polybag)

*Introduction*:
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change. The plantation of fruit orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change is an objective of this project.

*Benefits*:
1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit crops. 
2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture plantation. 
3. To establish orchards of long-term, income-generating fruit crops that survive on less water, providing a supplementary business to rainfed agriculture. 
4. To reduce soil erosion and promote the conservation of green cover. 
5. To increase Carbon Sequestration.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the land falls under the Tenancy Act and the tenant's name is on the 7/12 extract, a consent letter from the tenant will be required to implement the scheme.
3. The selected beneficiary for this component should not have availed government subsidy earlier for plantation activities (such as fruit orchards, tree plantation, bamboo, etc.) on the said area.
4. The beneficiary should have the necessary irrigation facilities required for the cultivation of the proposed fruit crop.
5. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries holding up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, certificate related to that.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

97

mahadbt-midh-area-expansion-fruit-flower

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Krishonnati Yojana-
Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)

*Main Component*:
Area Expansion

*Sub Component*:
Plantation of fruit, Flower & Spice crops

*Introduction*:
Under the Mission, assistance will be provided for Area Expansion by Plantation of fruit, Flower & Spices crops.
1. To Increase productivity by using high yielding varieties of fruit crops (Dragon fruit, Avocado & Strawberry) in the area expansion component.
2. To expand the area of ??non-traditional fruits, flowers outside greenhouses around major cities in the state.
3. To chectarenge traditional floriculture and use improved and high-yielding varieties for cultivation
4. Adopting high-tech cultivation methods for better quality production,

*Benefits*:
Benefit is given to farmers for 2 hectare area.
1. Dragon fruit - Benefit includes the cost of planting material, cost of material for trellis and other support systems, in 2 instalments of 60:40 subject to survival rate of 80% in 2nd year. Cost norms Rs. 6.75 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 2.70 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 3.375 lakh/hectare
2. Avocado - Benefit includes the cost of planting material and other input cost in 2
instalments of 60:40 subject to survival rate of 80% in 2nd year. Cost norms Rs. 1.25 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.50 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.625 lakh/hectare
3. Strawberry - Benefit includes the cost of on planting material and other input cost in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 2.00 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.80 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 1.00 lakh/hectare
4. Cut Flowers - Benefit is given in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 1.25 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.50 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.625 lakh/hectare
5. Bulbous and Rhizomatic Flowers -Benefit is given in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 2.50 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 1.00 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 1.25 lakh/hectare
6. Loose Flowers -Benefit is given in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 0.50 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.20 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.25 lakh/hectare
7. Chilli - Benefit includes the cost of planting material and cost of material for INM/IPM
etc. in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 0.50 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.20 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.25 lakh/hectare
8. Ginger & Turmeric - Benefit includes the cost on planting material and cost of material for INM/IPM etc. in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 1.00 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.40 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.50 lakh/hectare
9. Perennial Spices - Benefit includes the cost on planting material and cost of material for INM/IPM etc. in one installment. Cost norms Rs. 1.00 lakh/hectare, subsidy 40 % in General area is 0.40 lakh/hectare & 50 % in Scheduled area is 0.50 lakh/hectare

*Eligibility*:
1. To avail the benefit Farmers should hold at least 0.20 hectare land
2. Under this scheme, the cultivation of crops hectares to be done completely new. subsidy will not be payable for the area where crops were previously cultivated.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack Farmer ID
2. 7/12 and 8A (can be fetched through farmer ID)
3. Photocopy of the first page of the bank passbook (Aadhectarear linked Nationalised bank account details)
4. Caste certificate for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled tribes farmers
5. Consent letter if joint land holder
6. Guarantee letter in prescribed format
7. Bill/Invoice

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahectaredbt portal
https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
पिक विमा योजनांमध्ये सहभागी होण्यासाठी तुम्ही खालीलप्रमाणे अर्ज करू शकता:

१. **प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY):**
ही योजना नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड व रोगामुळे पिकांचे नुकसान झाल्यास शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक मदत देते. वाशीम जिल्ह्याच्या आपल्या मालेगाव तालुक्यात ज्या पिकांसाठी प्रशासनाने घोषित ‘notified crops’ ठरवल्या आहेत त्यासाठी ही योजना उपलब्ध आहे. सर्व शेतकरी – जमीनधारक, कर्जदार किंवा गैर-कर्जदार – पात्र आहेत. विमा रक्कम प्रतिहेक्टर प्रशासनाच्या ‘scale of finance’ नुसार ठरते.

**अर्ज करण्याची पद्धत:**
- अर्ज फक्त ऑनलाईन पद्धतीने www.pmfby.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर दिलेल्या मुदतीमध्ये करावा लागतो.
- अर्ज करताना आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते तपशील, जमीन व पिक नोंद, ‘ई-पिक पाहणी’ (डिजिटल क्रॉप सर्व्हे), तसेच आपला Agristack क्रमांक (जो आपल्याकडे आहे).
- विमा कंपनी निवड शासनाच्या टेंडर प्रक्रियेतून होते.

२. **रिस्ट्रक्चर्ड वेदर बेस्ड क्रॉप इन्शुरन्स स्कीम (RWBCIS):**
ही योजना मुख्यत्वे फळबाग व बागायती पिकासाठी आहे. अवकाळी पाऊस, दुष्काळ, गारपिटीसारख्या हवामानाच्या बदलामुळे नुकसान झाल्यास विमा लाभ दिला जातो. फळबागाच्या उत्पादक वयनुसार शेतकरी पात्र असतात. योजनेची अंमलबजावणी निवडलेल्या विमा कंपन्यांमार्फत केली जाते.

**पात्रता आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- सर्व शेतकरी व बागायतदार (कर्जदार/गैर-कर्जदार) पात्र
- अर्ज ऑनलाइन www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा.
- कागदपत्रे आणि इतर माहिती PMFBY प्रमाणेच लागतात.
- फक्त प्रशासनाने निश्चित केलेल्या ‘notified crops’ आणि क्षेत्रासाठीच विमा मिळतो.

**कोणत्या पिकांसाठी?**
यादी प्रत्येक सिझनमध्ये प्रशासन जाहीर करतं. सामान्यतः कांदा, सोयाबीन, कांदा, कापूस, तूर, हरभरा, गहू, ऊस, डाळिंब, केळी, द्राक्षे, संत्रा, लिंबूवर्गीय फळे, आम, चिकू, इ. या पिकांसाठी विमा उपलब्ध असतो. आपल्या गावात आणि तालुक्यात कोणती पिके विमा योजनेसाठी घोषित झाली आहेत, याची अधिकृत यादी स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात, मंडळ कार्यालय तसेच pmfby.gov.in या संकेतस्थळावर उपलब्ध असते.

आपण ऑनलाइन अर्ज करताना किंवा माहितीत शंका असल्यास आपल्या गावातील कृषी सहाय्यक किंवा मंडळ कृषी अधिकारी यांच्याशी संपर्क साधा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आतापर्यंत आपण कोणत्या पिकांसाठी विमा घ्यायचा विचार करत आहात? किंवा पिक विमा अर्जात मदतीसाठी आणखी माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Id*:

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB_bKSL1ifewQkA4-ksxeQfqWFfcoc_l/view

Central

Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Main Component*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Sub Component*:
Risk cover  against expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm is provided . Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop.

*Introduction*:
1. This  Scheme ( RWBCI) is being implemented since Mrug Bahar 2016 in 30 districts of Maharashtra.It is implemented in Mrug and Ambiya bahar .The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers having orchard of notified crops in the notified area of given productive age are eligible to participate.
2. The Scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee farmers.
3. The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.
4. The claims are decided on weather triggers fixed .  The weather data is taken from  Automatic weather station established under Mahavedh project for the claims calculation.
5. Insurance is provided for expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm.
6. One farmer can enroll for all notified crops upto 4 ha. Including both Mrug and Ambiya bahar.

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to Horticulture farmers in the event of notified crop failure in notified area due to adverse climatic condition .

*Eligibility*:
1. All farmers  growing notified crops of productive age  in the notified area.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:

actionability.evidence: Provides portal URL (pmfby.gov.in), documents required, and guidance to check notified crops; suggests contacting local agri staff.

context_fit.evidence: Mentions the user's taluka and district, avoids PoCRA schemes (PoCRA: No). Did not verify whether RWBCIS is active for Washim this season or fetch the specific notified crops for the user's area.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured with numbered sections and bullet points; clear Marathi explanations.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a relevant follow-up asking which crops the farmer wants to insure and offering further help.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct and readable; only minor redundancy (कांदा mentioned twice).

terminology.evidence: Uses correct terms like योजना, विमा, अर्ज, पात्रता, पण 'notified crops' हा इंग्रजी शब्दप्रयोग वापरला; could use 'अधिसूचित पिके'.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with minimal necessary English (portal URL, scheme names).

fluency.evidence: Generally fluent and natural, though slightly formal and with a small repetition in crop examples.

evaluation.summary: Strong, well-structured answer covering both PMFBY and RWBCIS with correct application steps and documents. Minor gaps: generic example crop list not sourced and no area-specific notified crop list fetched; could personalize further to the user's area/season.

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
आपल्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप सिंचन प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी "नानाजी देशमुख कृशी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - ड्रिप सिंचन" योजनेअंतर्गत अर्ज करता येतो. ही योजना प्रामुख्याने PoCRA योजनेत समाविष्ट गावांसाठी आहे. आपल्या बोर्डी (तालुका: मालेगाव, जिल्हा: वाशिम) या गावात PoCRA लागू नाही, त्यामुळे नेहमी प्रथम आपल्या जिल्हा कृषी अधिकाऱ्यांकडे खात्री करून घ्या.

अर्ज करण्यासाठी प्रक्रिया:
1. आपल्या नावावर ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत शेती असावी. आपले क्षेत्र ०.५५ हेक्टर आहे, त्यामुळे आपण पात्र आहात.
2. द्यायची मुख्य कागदपत्रे:
   - जमीन धारक असल्याचे पुरावे
   - अगर मिळकत संयुक्त आहे, तर इतर मालकांची संमतीपत्रे
   - आधुनिक पद्धतीच्या सिंचनासाठी पाणी व वीज उपलब्धता असावी
3. अर्ज ऑनलाईन पद्धतीने करावा लागतो:
   - आपल्या मोबाईलवर "महाविस्तार-AI" हे ऍप गुगल प्ले स्टोरवरून डाउनलोड करा.
   - लॉगिन करताना आपला रजिस्ट्रड शेतकरी आयडी (Farmer ID) प्रविष्ट करा.
   - लॉगिन झाल्यावर, "DBT" विभागावर जा आणि "NDKSP (PoCRA)" निवडा.
   - "Apply for New Scheme" वर क्लिक करा, सर्व अर्जातील माहिती भरा व आवश्यक कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा.
   - त्यानंतर आपण आपल्या अर्जाची स्थिती पोर्टलवरच पाहू शकता.

वेब पोर्टलवरून अर्ज करायचा असल्यास: https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या वेबसाईटला भेट द्या.

टीप: आपला आधार क्रमांक बँक खात्याशी लिंक असणे अनिवार्य आहे.

महत्वाची सूचना: ही योजना फक्त PoCRA गावांमध्ये उपलब्ध आहे. आपला गाव PoCRA मध्ये नाही, त्यामुळे आपल्या कृषी अधिकारी कार्यालयाकडे जिल्ह्यातील इतर उपलब्ध ड्रिप सिंचन योजना आणि अर्जाची प्रक्रिया जाणून घ्या.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती** 

आपल्याला जिल्ह्यातील इतर ड्रिप किंवा सूक्ष्मसिंचन योजनेबद्दल माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Id*:
42

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-drip-irrigation

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

*Source Url*:
https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - Scheme tools used; no document search performed or required.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes, contacts, or timelines; portal/process details align with tool output for NDKSP.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used appropriate generic citation: 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती'.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - Scheme information only; no chemical or safety advisories involved.

completeness.evidence: Did not include the applicable non-PoCRA drip scheme PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop (MahaDBT), nor its benefits, eligibility, documents, or application steps.

actionability.evidence: Provided concrete steps and link for NDKSP portal, but since PoCRA: No, those steps are not actionable for this farmer; no steps for PM-KRVY PDMC via MahaDBT were provided.

context_fit.evidence: Acknowledged PoCRA: No and location, yet focused on a PoCRA-only scheme and suggested eligibility on land size, reducing fit to the farmer’s context.

clarity.evidence: Structure is readable, but mixed signals—stating PoCRA is not applicable while asserting 'you are eligible'—may confuse the farmer.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends by offering information on other drip/micro-irrigation schemes, inviting a relevant follow-up.

language_purity.evidence: Multiple English UI terms used ('Google Play Store', 'Apply for New Scheme', 'Dashboard'), which could be localized to Marathi equivalents.

fluency.evidence: Generally fluent, but contradictory eligibility messaging affects natural flow and coherence.

question: माझ्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार PM-KISAN मध्ये किती रक्कम मिळेल?
answer:
आपल्या 0.68 हेक्टर शेतीच्या आकारानुसार, आपण पूर्णपणे **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)** योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात. 

या योजनेअंतर्गत, ज्या शेतकरी कुटुंबांकडे शेतीयोग्य जमीन आहे, त्यांना वर्षाला **एकूण 6,000 रुपये अनुदान** दिले जाते. हे पैसे एका कुटुंबास वर्षात तीन समान हप्‍त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येकी 2,000 रुपये) आपल्या बँक खात्यावर थेट वर्ग केले जातात. एका कुटुंबात पती-पत्नी आणि 18 वर्षाखालील मुले समाविष्ट असतात.

आपल्या जमिनीच्या आकाराचा फरक पडत नाही—कितीही कमी अथवा जास्त क्षेत्र असो, हे वार्षिक अनुदान सर्व पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना सारखेच मिळते.

पात्रता:
- आपल्या नावावर शेती असणे आणि 7/12 उतारा, आधार कार्ड व KYC पूर्ण असणे आवश्यक आहे.

अर्ज प्रक्रिया:
- pmkisan.gov.in येथे ऑनलाइन अर्ज करता येतो, किंवा आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात संपर्क साधून मदत मिळवू शकता.

**स्रोत: Government Scheme Information**

आपण या योजनेसाठी नोंदणी केली आहे का? अन्य शासकीय अनुदान किंवा योजना माहित करून घ्यायची आहेत का?

question: मी PM-KISAN साठी पात्र आहे का
answer:
हो, आपल्या प्रोफाइलनुसार (बोर्डी, ता. मालेगाव, जि. वाशिम, 0.55 हेक्टर जमीन, सर्वसाधारण जात) आपण **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)** साठी पात्र आहात, कारण:

- आपल्या नावावर ०.५५ हेक्टर शेतीयोग्य जमीन आहे.
- "परिवार" म्हणजे पती-पत्नी आणि १८ वर्षांखालील मुले.
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या दुर्बल जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंबांना या योजनेचा लाभ मिळतो.
- काही विशिष्ट वगळ्याची अटी लागू होऊ शकतात (जसे: शासकीय कर्मचारी, करदाते, आदी).

**मुख्य लाभ:** 
प्रत्येक पात्र शेतकरी कुटुंबाला वर्षाला ६,००० रुपये (३ हप्त्यांत प्रत्येकी २,००० रुपये) थेट बँक खात्यात मिळतात.

**लागणारी कागदपत्रे:**
- आपल्या नावावर ७/१२ उतारा (जमीन पासबुक)
- आधार कार्ड आणि त्याची आधार सिडिंग
- ई-KYC पूर्ण केलेले असणे आवश्यक

**अर्ज कसा करावा?**
- सरकारी pmkisan पोर्टलवर (pmkisan.gov.in) ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा.

आपण अर्ज करताना आपल्या कागदपत्रांची सत्यता आणि कोणतीही वगळ्याची अट तुमच्यावर लागू नाही, याची खात्री करा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला अर्ज प्रक्रियेत किंवा आवश्यक कागदपत्रांबाबत अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

question: सोयाबीन पिकासाठी PMFBY विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे?
answer:
प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY) अंतर्गत सोयाबीन पिकासाठी विमा संरक्षण उपलब्ध आहे. आपल्या नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अक्कलकुवा तालुक्यातील 0.68 हेक्टर क्षेत्रासाठी आपण या योजनेचा लाभ घेऊ शकता.

सोयाबीनसाठी विमा रक्कम "स्केल ऑफ फायनान्स" प्रमाणे प्रति हेक्टर ठरवली जाते. विमा संरक्षणात नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, रोग आणि किडींमुळे पीक नुकसानीसाठी भरपाई मिळते. योजनेतील मुख्य वैशिष्ट्ये:
- आपत्तीमुळे पिकाचे नुकसान झाल्यास अर्थसहाय्य मिळते.
- विमा संरक्षण सर्व शेतकऱ्यांसाठी ऐच्छिक आहे (कर्जदार आणि नकर्जदार दोन्ही).
- विमा भरपाईसाठी प्रतिहेक्टर विमा किंमत वित्तमानानुसार ठरते.
- अर्जासाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:Agristack नंबर, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन आणि पिकाची माहिती, डिजिटल पीक पाहणी.

अर्ज www.pmfby.gov.in या अधिकृत पोर्टलवर नोंदणी करून करावा लागतो. विमा प्रिमियम दर तसेच प्रतिहेक्टर विमा रक्कम आपल्या तालुक्यात शेती कर्जदार संस्थेस किंवा स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयात मिळू शकते.

**स्रोत: प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY) शासकीय माहिती**

आपणास या योजनेत अर्ज करण्याविषयी किंवा विमा हप्त्याबद्दल अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details

question: कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे
answer:
Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS) अंतर्गत कापूस पिकासाठी विमा संरक्षणाची रक्कम प्रतिहेक्टर "स्केल ऑफ फायनान्स" प्रमाणे ठरवली जाते. म्हणजेच, प्रत्येक जिल्ह्यातील अधिकृत वित्तीय निकष (scale of finance) प्रमाणे हेक्टरी विमा रक्कम वेगळी असते. 

या योजनेत हवामानातील बदलांमुळे (जसे की अतिवृष्टी, अल्प पाऊस, दीर्घ कोरडवाहू कालावधी, अवेळी पाऊस, कमी/जास्त तापमान, आद्र्रता, वाऱ्याचा वेग, गारपीट) झालेली अपेक्षित नुकसानवापर विमा संरक्षणात येते. शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या परिसरातील अधिसूचित क्षेत्रात कापूस पिकावर हा विमा मिळतो. या योजनेमध्ये एका शेतकऱ्याला जास्तीत जास्त ४ हेक्टर क्षेत्रासाठी विमा घेता येतो.

मुख्य गोष्टी:
- अनुदानित विमा रक्कम: प्रतिहेक्टर स्केल ऑफ फायनान्स प्रमाणे
- नुकसानाचे विवेचन: हवामान संकेतांवर आधारलेले
- सर्व पात्र शेतकरी (कर्जदार/अकर्जदार) अर्ज करू शकतात
- अर्ज प्रक्रिया: www.pmfby.gov.in पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन अर्ज करावा लागतो

कागदपत्रे:
1. कृषिस्तॅक क्रमांक
2. आधार कार्ड
3. बँक तपशील
4. जमीन/पीक नोंदी, डिजिटल पीक पाहणी

तुमच्या नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील कापूस पिकासाठी २०२५-२०२६ च्या कालावधीतील "स्केल ऑफ फायनान्स" जाणून घेण्यासाठी स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालय किंवा बँकेत चौकशी करा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनेचे अर्ज कसे करायचे किंवा विमा दावा कसा करायचा याबाबत सविस्तर मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?

*Scheme Name*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Main Component*:
Restructured Weather Base Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)

*Sub Component*:
Risk cover  against expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm is provided . Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop.

*Introduction*:
1. This  Scheme ( RWBCI) is being implemented since Mrug Bahar 2016 in 30 districts of Maharashtra.It is implemented in Mrug and Ambiya bahar .The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers having orchard of notified crops in the notified area of given productive age are eligible to participate.
2. The Scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee farmers.
3. The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.
4. The claims are decided on weather triggers fixed .  The weather data is taken from  Automatic weather station established under Mahavedh project for the claims calculation.
5. Insurance is provided for expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm.
6. One farmer can enroll for all notified crops upto 4 ha. Including both Mrug and Ambiya bahar.

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to Horticulture farmers in the event of notified crop failure in notified area due to adverse climatic condition .

*Eligibility*:
1. All farmers  growing notified crops of productive age  in the notified area.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

question: Me PDMC yojana la eligible ahe ka?
answer:
आपण विचारले आहे: "मी PDMC योजना (Per Drop More Crop) साठी पात्र आहे का?"

आपली माहिती पाहता:
- आपल्याकडे एकूण 1.81 हेक्टर शेती आहे
- आपण "General" श्रेणीमध्ये येता
- आपले गाव लौकी (ता. शिरपूर, जि. धुळे) येथे आहे (ही योजना संपूर्ण महाराष्ट्रासाठी लागू आहे)
- PoCRA गावात आपण राहत नाही, पण PDMC सर्वांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे

**PDMC (Per Drop More Crop) योजनेची पात्रता:**
1. आपल्या नावे 7/12 प्रमाणपत्र व 8अ असणे आवश्यक आहे (आपल्याकडे शेतजमीन आहे)
2. सिंचनाचा स्रोत असणे आवश्यक आहे (तलाव, विहीर, शुभ्र, टँकर, नदी इ.)

जर आपल्याकडे सिंचनाचा कोणताही स्रोत असेल तर आणि जमीन आपल्या नावावर असेल, तर आपण PDMC योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात.

**योजनेचे मुख्य फायदे:**
- थेंब सिंचन (Drip) किंवा तुषार सिंचन (Sprinkler) संच बसवण्यासाठी अनुदान
- आपल्यासारख्या इतर शेतकऱ्यांसाठी एकूण खर्चाच्या 45% इतका अनुदान (लहान/सीमांत शेतकरी असता 55%)
- जास्तीत जास्त 5 हेक्टर क्षेत्रासाठी अनुदान मिळू शकते
- अनुदान थेट आपल्या बँक खात्यात जमा होते (Direct Benefit Transfer)

**कागदपत्रे व अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- MAHADBT पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो (https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
- आपल्या नावावर 7/12, 8अ, सिंचनाचा पुरावा, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते तपशील आवश्यक असतात

**संपूर्ण माहिती:**
- अधिक माहितीसाठी किंवा कोणतीही शंका असल्यास आपल्या तालुका कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क करा

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याकडे सिंचनाचा स्रोत आहे का? तसे असल्यास, मी अर्ज प्रक्रियेबाबत आणखी माहिती देऊ का?

*Introduction*:
Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW) to promote micro irrigation. *Benefits*:
Subsidy for Installation of Micro Irrigation Sets (Drip & Sprinkler). Norms of Assistance for Drip & Sprinkler varies according to area & Spacing. The pattern of assistance payable to beneficiary under the scheme is 55 % for small and marginal farmers and 45 %for other farmers up to maximum 5 ha. Subsidy is given for Installation of Micro Irrigation Sets (Drip & Sprinkler).Subsidy is deposited directly into farmers Bank account, Direct Benefit transfer (DBT) through MAHADBT Portal.

question: मी माझ्या शेतामध्ये कापसाची लागवड करण्याची योजना आखत आहे. यासाठी मी पात्र असलेल्या कोणत्याही शासकीय योजना आहेत का?
answer:
आपण नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यातील अनुसूचित जमातीचे शेतकरी आहात आणि सध्या 0.68 हेक्टर क्षेत्रात कापूस लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजनांचा विचार करत आहात. आपल्या कृषी खात्याच्या माहितीवरून, आपण कापूस लागवडीसाठी खालील शासकीय योजनांसाठी पात्र आहात:

१. **राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा व पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) – कापूस विकास योजना**
• कापसाच्या आधुनिक शेतीसाठी अनुदान, समाविष्ट उपक्रम: आंतरपीक पद्धती, उच्च घनता लागवड, कीड व्यवस्थापन, कापूस बियाणे उत्पादन, ऑनलाइन सल्ला व प्रशिक्षण.
• फायदे: आंतरपीक (मुग, उडीद) प्रत्यक्ष प्रात्यक्षिकासाठी रु. ८,०००/हे., उच्च घनता लागवडीसाठी रु. १०,०००/हे., एकात्मिक पीक व्यवस्थापनासाठी रु. ८,०००/हे., कापूस बियाणे उत्पादनासाठी रु. ९,०००/हे., किटकनाशके व जैव एजंटसाठी रु. ५००/हे. (किंवा खर्चाच्या ५०% पर्यंत).
• पात्रता: ७/१२ उतार्‍यावर नाव असलेले व ई-पीक पाहणी केलेले सर्व शेतकरी या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करू शकतात.
• अर्ज प्रक्रिया: MahaDBT पोर्टलवर अर्ज आवश्यक.
• या योजना नंदुरबार जिल्ह्यात चालू आहेत.

२. **बिरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (ST शेतकरी विशेष)**
• आपल्यासारख्या अनुसूचित जमातीच्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी सिंचन सुविधा, विहीर/बोअरवेल, प्लास्टिक लायनिंग, पंपसेट, सौरपंप, मायक्रो-इरीगेशन (ड्रीप/स्प्रिंकलर), स्प्रिंकलर, कुंपण/फार्म मशिनरी यासाठी मोठे अनुदान.
• फायदे: नवीन विहिरीसाठी कमाल रु. ४,००,०००; प्लास्टिक लायनिंगसाठी ९०% किंवा कमाल रु. २,००,०००; ड्रीप/स्प्रिंकलरसाठी ८०-९०% अनुदान; पंपसेट/सौरपंपसाठी रु. ४०,००० ते ५०,०००; इतर बाबतीतही मोठ्या प्रमाणात अनुदान मिळणार.
• पात्रता: अनुसूचित जमाती, ०.४० ते ६ हेक्टर जमीन, प्लॉट्सचे ७/१२ उतारे व जात प्रमाणपत्र.
• अर्ज प्रक्रिया: MahaDBT पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज, प्रथम येणाऱ्यास प्रथम प्राधान्य.

३. **प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
• कापूसासारख्या अधिसूचित पिकांसाठी नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, कीड-रोगामुळे नुकसान झाल्यास नुकसानभरपाईची हमी.
• पात्रता: अधिसूचित पिकांखालील सारे शेतकरी, लोनदार/अनलोनदार दोन्ही.
• अर्ज प्रक्रिया: pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर नोंदणी व ई-पीक पाहणी अनिवार्य.

४. **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**
• प्रती कुटुंब वर्षाला रुपये ६,००० (प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधीसह) थेट खात्यात.
• पात्रता: PM-KISAN योजनेचे लाभार्थी (जमिनीवर नाव, आधार लिंक, e-KYC पूर्ण).

अर्ज करताना शासकीय वेबसाइटवरील मार्गदर्शक सूचना काळजीपूर्वक वाचा. आपल्याला आवश्यक कागदपत्रे – जमीन उतारा (७/१२), ओळखपत्र/आधार, जात प्रमाणपत्र (ST), बँक तपशील व इ-पीक पाहणी पुरावा – तयार ठेवा.

*Scheme Name*:
National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) Commercial Crop- Cotton Development Scheme

*Main Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration 2) Cotton Seed production 3)  Integrated Pest Management  4)  On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services  5) State level training  6) Local Initiatives - a) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration b) Biochar

*Sub Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration -a) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid) , b) Trials on High Density Planting Systems , c) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM)
2) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production
3)  Integrated Pest Management (IPM) -Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents
4) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS)
5) State level training
6) Local Initiatives - Early termination & stubble removal demonstration
7) Biochar

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.

*Benefits*:
1) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid)- Rs. 8000/ha
2) Trials on High Density Planting Systems Rs. - 10000/ha
3) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM) -Rs.-Rs.8000/ha.
4) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production -Rs.9000/ha.
5)Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents -Rs. 500/ha or 50% of the cost (whichever is less)
6) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) -Rs. 8000/ha.
7) State level trainings (20 participants X 2 days) - Rs. 40000/traning.
8) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration- Rs. 5000/ha.
7) Biochar - Rs. 10000/Unit.

*Eligibility*:
1) Crop Demonstration- Group Beneficiary
2) Biachar - Indiviual
3) Traning - Agri Depaetment Staff.

*Required Documents*:
1) It is mandatory for the farmers to be given subsidy to these politicians to be registered on Agristack.
2) Farmer ID is mandatory .

2) Biochar -MAHADBT Portal

Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna (TSP and OTSP)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Tribes (ST) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)

     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden
12. Drilling well/ Borewell

*Introduction*:
Tribal Sub-Plan (In-Area and Outside-Area) is being implemented since 1992-93 to increase the income of Scheduled Tribe farmers and improve their standard of living. Considering the needs of the farmers in the changed situation, as per the Government administrative approval Ref/letter No. Auyo 2416/Pr.No.177/4A, dated 9/8/2017. to revise the said scheme from the year 2017-18 vide Government Decision Also, the Government has decided to implement the said scheme under the name Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-Area and Outside-Area).
Also, the Government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the Government decision dated 01 October, 2024.

*Benefits*:
The said scheme should be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 & components admmissible for subsidy are as follows.
 1. In the said scheme, the grant will be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
 1.1 For New Irrigation Well Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 4,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy
 1.2 For Old Well Repair Maximum subsidy Limit is Rs. 1,00,000/- is admissible as subsidy 1.3 For Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy
 1.4 For Inwell Boring Maximum subsidy Limit is 40,000/- is admossible as subsidy
 1.5 For Electricity Connection Maximum subsidy Limit is Amount Rs. 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.6 For Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)Maximum subsidy Limit is For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.7For Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)Maximum subsidy Limit is subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy 1.8 For HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admossible as subsidy . 1.9.1 Under Micro irrigation system for Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less is admissible as subsidy.
 1.9.2 Under Micro irrigation system for Drip Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Under the Per Drop Plus Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 10% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana and (2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from Mukhyamantri Shasvat Irrigation Yojana + 15% from Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. 10.For Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)
 Maximum subsidy Limit is Ammount Rs.50,000/- is admossible as subsidy 11.For Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) Maximum subsidy Limit is 5,000/- is admossible as subsidy 12. For Drilling well/ Borewell (new item) Maximum subsidy Limit is Grant of Rs. 50,000/- or actual cost, whichever is less is admossible as subsidy.

*Eligibility*:
Beneficiary eligibility criteria:-
1.The beneficiary must be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category.
2.The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.The farmer must have a 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in his name.
 (Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika areas (Ref. Govt.t Letter No. Sankirna-2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dt. 24.4. 2018))
4.The beneficiaries must have their own bank account and the said bank  account must be linked to the Aadhaar card.
5.The beneficiary below the poverty line will be given first priority.6.The condition of Rs. 1,50,000/- annual income limit applicable to the beneficiaries of the said scheme is being abolished. The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the land of the tribal beneficiaries is in remote and fragmented areas, two or more beneficiaries with land holdings less than 0.40 hectares come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be allowed to benefit from the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of holding area will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
6.The priority order of beneficiary selection will be as follows.
6.1 Beneficiaries below the poverty line,
6.2 Tribal beneficiarie,
6. 3. Individual Forest leaseholders
6..4 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be admissible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years
6.3 If the benefit has been given from the tribal scheme for similar agricultural development schemes as well as from the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit given under this scheme will not be admissible.
6.4 A note will be made in the 7/12th statement of the beneficiaries who have taken the benefit of the said scheme.
District Selection Committee: -   The following committee will be constituted to finalize the selection of beneficiaries at the district level under Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Inside-sub plan Area and Outside sub plan Area) Scheme.
        Additional Chief Executive Officer, Z.P.                                                    - Chairman
        District Superintendent Agriculture Officer                                            - Member
        Executive Engineer, Minor Irrigation, Z.P.                                               - Member
        District Level Officer of Ground Water Survey System                         - Member
        Assistant Commissioner, Social Welfare                                                 - Member
        Special District Social Welfare Officer (Zilla Parishad)                          - Member
        Agricultural Development Officer, Z.P.                                                    -Member Secretary
For this scheme, applications from farmers will be invited on the Maha-DBT portal at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ farmer/ login/ login and the applications received within the limit of the target received by the concerned talukas will be selected online on a first come, first served basis. For this, the target received district-wise will be entered on the portal at the Agriculture Commissionerate level. The funds made available to the districts under this scheme in the financial year 2025-26 should be distributed taluka-wise in a fair manner. For this, the financial target of each taluka should be determined in proportion to the total number of farmers in the Scheduled Tribe category in the district. The concerned districts should take action to enter the financial target of the said talukas on the portal. Eligible beneficiaries will be selected online from the interested farmers in the concerned taluka within the limit of this target. The approval of the District Selection Committee should be obtained for this. The selection list of beneficiaries in each taluka will be published on the MahaDBT portal on a first come, first served basis. Prior approval should be given to the beneficiaries within the financial target available for the district/taluka. The entire responsibility in this regard will rest with the concerned Agricultural Development Officer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate  of ST category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report  having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of 3 months
3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the      concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.                                                                                                                                        2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

question: मी कोणकोणत्या योजनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
आपल्या शेतीसाठी खालील योजना आपल्या पात्रतेनुसार उपलब्ध आहेत:

१) **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
या योजनेत पात्र शेतकऱ्यांना दरवर्षी ₹६,०००/- तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये मिळतात. ही रक्कम प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजनेसह अधिक मिळते. पात्रता: आपण प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PMKISAN) चे लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक आहे. अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही, एकदाच PMKISAN मध्ये नाव नोंदविले की या योजनेचा लाभ मिळतो.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

२) **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PMKISAN)**  
या योजनेअंतर्गत ज्या शेतकऱ्यांकडे खातेदार म्हणून लागवडयोग्य जमीन आहे, त्यांना दरवर्षी ₹६,०००/- तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये मिळतात. अर्ज PMKISAN या अधिकृत संकेतस्थळावर नोंदणी करून करता येतो. पात्रता: आर्थिक दृष्ट्या दुर्बल खातेदार शेतकरी कुटुंब.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

३) **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
ही योजना फक्त अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौध्द शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे. (आपण सामान्य वर्गात असल्यामुळे, आपण या योजनेसाठी पात्र नाही.)  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

४) **राज्य प्रायोजित कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**  
या योजनेत ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, विविध कृषी अवजारे इ. खरेदीसाठी शेतकऱ्यांना अनुदान (सामान्य वर्ग शेतकऱ्यांना ४०-५०% अनुदान) दिले जाते. ऑनलाईन अर्ज Mahadbt पोर्टलवर करता येतो.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

५) **प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
या योजनेत आपली लागवड झालेली पिके नैसर्गिक आपत्तीत, कीड किंवा रोगाने नुकसान झाल्यास नुकसानभरपाई मिळते. तपशील Mahadbt किंवा www.pmfby.gov.in वर मिळू शकतात. पात्रता: आपल्या क्षेत्रातील नोटिफाइड पिकांसाठी लागू.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या नावावर ०.५५ हेक्टर जमीन आहे आणि आपण वाशिम जिल्ह्यातील मालेगाव तालुक्यात राहता. म्हणून बहुतेक राज्य व केंद्र पुरस्कृत योजनांसाठी आपण पात्र आहात. फक्त अनुसूचित जाती/जमातींसाठीच्या योजनांसाठी (जसे BAKSY), आपण पात्र नाही.

आपणास कुठल्या योजनेबद्दल सविस्तर माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया जाणून घ्यायची आहे का?
